details.reasoning: The predicted answer names the Central Limit Theorem, but that theorem concerns the distribution of the sample mean, not the distribution of the sampled variables themselves. The gold target says no theory supports the stated claim, so the answer is incorrect.
details.groundedness_reasoning:
